model.title: Hardened Site Survivability Estimator
model.disclaimer: Planning model PM-3 gives rounded, order-of-magnitude estimates for continuity planning only. It is not an engineering assessment and must not be cited as a statement of any facility's design rating. It takes no account of ground conditions, portal geometry, repeated events, fire, or loss of external services. Figures are notional.
method: Surface peak overpressure at a site is read from the contour table: range to a contour in statute miles = range coefficient x (yield in kt) to the power 1/3.

Between contours the overpressure is interpolated on logarithms of range and overpressure. Beyond the outermost contour the site is taken as unaffected. Inside the innermost contour the overpressure is above the range of the model.
Effective site rating = rated overpressure of the hardening class x (1 + depth coupling x model depth in thousands of feet).
Estimated condition is read from the ratio of site overpressure to effective rating. Inside the innermost contour the condition is NOT ASSURED.
Model depth is the facility depth of record. Where the depth of record is not held by the user, GAMMA sites are modelled at the planning depth below.

classes.name: Deep mined hub
classes.description: Mined in competent rock below 800 ft. Shaft or adit access with multiple blast doors in series; blast valves on all air intakes.

classes.name: Deep mined regional centre
classes.description: Mined below 400 ft. Single portal with a blast door and airlock; blast valves on air intakes.

classes.name: Mined shelter, dual portal
classes.description: Mined shelter with two portals, each with a blast door; blast valves on the main air intake.

classes.name: Mined shelter, single portal
classes.description: Mined shelter with one portal and one blast door; air intake closed by manual damper.

conditions.text: Expected to remain operational. Surface cover facility may be lost.
Expected to remain habitable. Portal equipment and external services likely lost.
Interior expected to survive. Portals likely blocked; egress by tunnel or after clearance only.
Survival of the facility is not assured by this model.

notModelled.text: DELTA sites are not modelled. Their survivability depends on concealment, not hardening.

rules: The drill order is issued by Network Control, ALPHA-01, and is acknowledged by ALPHA-01 at once.
Network Control relays the order to the other ALPHA hubs over the inter-hub circuits, one relay interval per rail segment in revenue service between the hub and ALPHA-01.
Each hub relays the order down its tram network, one relay interval per tram link, BETA before GAMMA.
Sites with no tram link are ordered by voice circuit from Network Control after the networks, one voice interval apart, in designation order.
Times to acknowledge, cycle doors and report sealed are counted from the moment a site receives the order.
A site that has not reported sealed by twice its class seal time is carried as NO REPORT.

excluded.text: DELTA sites are not ordered in a network seal drill. They report by telephone on the next scheduled check.
